# The source tree's own report for the anchor comparison:
#
#     fua_csnap_analyze ref.csnap anchor
#
# run on the snapshot branch of Kaori-Chani/ZanZan at its snap-ref-premerge tag, b8a72a262, with
# no level loaded and without the recording's files -- as the comparison runs. Its compared lines
# match a run with the recording's files loaded (Complex Doom and Sunder, in order).
#
# The recording is ref.csnap, archived beside ref.zsnap in the folder ZX_SNAP_REFDIR names. It is
# not in this repo: at 4.9 MB it is one of the two large references the dump test also reads.
#
# tools/snap_anchor_compare.py compares the segment block and the summary's deltas, frames,
# resets and decode errors. It does not compare what the class table decides, because a .csnap
# carries the recording build's class numbering and this engine's own actors shift the indices:
# the glide tripwire block with its per-class rows, the worst-class line, the worst step's class
# name, the drawn-state agreement line and the unresolved-class warning. Nor does it compare the
# header line, which names the file as it was passed -- REF.csnap in this run.
